mostWorthwhile.text: Making the deadwood refuge showed how fallen trees can sustain decomposers and their eaters when fresh growth falters. It made survival feel connected to the world already built.

leastWorthwhile.text: Planting the seed cache was a predictable final step, though it brought the recovery thread to a clear close.

surprise.text: The dead forest becoming a refuge, rather than simply a loss, changed how I thought about the survivors' food supply.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though every decision offered only one combination, so I was following a clear route rather than discovering compatibility.

continue.text: Yes. The shoots suggest a changed world worth seeing, and I would be curious how recovery unfolds without restoring what was lost.
